title: A trivial Kan fibration has the lifting property against termwise injective maps
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file simplicial.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-trivial-kan at source lines 5767-5779: a trivial Kan fibration f : X to Y lifts every solid diagram whose horizontal map Z to W is termwise injective. The proof at source lines 5781-5800 is a one-simplex-at-a-time extension: taking the smallest n with Z_n different from W_n and a nondegenerate x in W_n outside Z_n, it builds the simplicial subset Z' generated by Z, x and the degeneracies of x, identifies Z' as the pushout of Delta[n] and Z along the boundary, uses the Kan lifting condition to extend b over the boundary to beta, and glues b and beta into a morphism on Z'. The proof is then finished by Zorn's lemma, which the author explicitly omits. It is short; the substance is the pushout description of the elementary extension step and its packaging into a Zorn argument.
